title: FraudFlagged
description: The fraud detection service publishes FraudFlagged when its risk rules flag an authorized transaction, and the notification service reads it under the notification-fraud consumer group. No source program scores risk, so the event is additive in full and has no COBOL ancestor. Evolution is additive only: additionalProperties stays true, so a consumer validating against this version accepts an event that carries a field added by a later version. Inside one version no field is removed, renamed, retyped or narrowed; a change of that kind takes a new schemaVersion and a new -v<n> document beside this one.
$comment: aggregateId is the only account identifier this document declares, and the Kafka message key is that value, so the key and the payload cannot disagree.

eventId.description: The idempotency key, a lower-case canonical Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) of thirty-six characters. Each consumer records this identifier before it applies side effects. The pattern is asserted directly, so validation does not depend on the validator enabling the optional format-assertion vocabulary. Additive. No source field exists.

eventType.description: The routing discriminator. A consumer on the fraud.assessed topic reads this field to learn which payload arrived. Additive. No source field exists.

schemaVersion.description: The contract version. This file is version 1, matching the -v1 suffix in its name. Additive. No source field exists.

occurredAt.description: The publish timestamp, in Coordinated Universal Time. The fraud detection service stamps it when it writes the event, and assessedAt carries the time the rules finished. Additive. No source field exists.

aggregateId.description: The account identifier, eleven digits, and always the Kafka message key. Width from XREF-ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) at app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy:L7. This is the only account identifier the document carries, so the message key and the payload cannot disagree. A consumer maps this field onto its own account column.

transactionId.description: The identifier of the transaction the rules assessed, sixteen characters. Width borrowed from TRAN-ID PIC X(16) at app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy:L5, so the value matches the transactionId on TransactionAuthorized.

riskScore.description: The score the risk rules produced, from 0 through 100, where a higher number means more risk. Additive. No source field exists.

triggeredRules.description: The rules that flagged the transaction. Each entry is upper case with underscores, and a flagged event names at least one rule with no duplicates. Additive. No source field exists.

assessedAt.description: The time the risk rules finished, in Coordinated Universal Time. Additive. No source field exists.
